{"content": "### Configure MCP Servers with Local and Remote Definitions

Source: https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/blob/dev/specs/v2/config.md

This snippet illustrates configuring MCP servers, including global timeout defaults and specific local and remote server definitions with commands, environment variables, URLs, headers, and OAuth settings.

```jsonc
{
  "mcp": {
    "timeout": { "startup": 30000, "request": 300000 },
    "servers": {
      "github": {
        "type": "local",
        "command": ["npx", "-y", "@github/github-mcp-server"],
        "environment": { "GITHUB_TOKEN": "{env:GITHUB_TOKEN}" },
        "disabled": false,
        "timeout": { "startup": 60000 },
      },
      "docs": {
        "type": "remote",
        "url": "https://docs.example.com/mcp",
        "headers": { "Authorization": "Bearer {env:DOCS_TOKEN}" },
        "oauth": {
          "client_id": "{env:MCP_CLIENT_ID}",
          "client_secret": "{env:MCP_CLIENT_SECRET}",
          "scope": "read write",
          "callback_port": 19876,
          "redirect_uri": "http://127.0.0.1:19876/mcp/oauth/callback",
        },
        "disabled": false,
        "timeout": { "request": 600000 },
      },
    },
  },
}
```

--------------------------------

### Configure Skill Discovery Sources (JSON)

Source: https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/blob/dev/specs/v2/config.md

Use this snippet to define an array of local paths or remote URLs where skills can be discovered. Skills are loaded or invoked intentionally, providing reusable prompt workflows.

```jsonc
{
  "skills": ["./team-skills", "~/shared-skills", "https://example.com/.well-known/skills/"]
}
```

--------------------------------

### Define Plugins in Configuration

Source: https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/blob/dev/packages/core/src/plugin/skill/customize-opencode.md

Specify plugins using npm packages, local file paths, or tuple configurations with options.

```json
"plugin": [
  "opencode-gemini-auth",            // npm spec, latest
  "opencode-foo@1.2.3",              // npm spec, pinned
  "./local-plugin.ts",               // file path, relative to the declaring config
  "file:///abs/path/plugin.js",      // file URL
  ["opencode-bar", { "key": "val" }] // tuple form with options
]
```

--------------------------------

### Plugin config hook interface

Source: https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/blob/dev/packages/plugin/src/index.ts

The `Hooks.config` method is the plugin hook that receives the full opencode Config object. Plugins register this hook to mutate `cfg.mcp` by adding or modifying MCP server entries.

```typescript
export interface Hooks {
  dispose?: () => Promise<void>
  event?: (input: { event: Event }) => Promise<void>
  config?: (input: Config) => Promise<void>
```

--------------------------------

### Server plugin dispose?() lifecycle hook on Hooks interface

Source: https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/blob/dev/packages/plugin/src/index.ts

Server plugins can define an optional dispose() method on the Hooks interface, called during plugin teardown.

```typescript
export interface Hooks {
  dispose?: () => Promise<void>
  event?: (input: { event: Event }) => Promise<void>
  config?: (input: Config) => Promise<void>
  tool?: {
    [key: string]: ToolDefinition
  }
  ...
}
```", "results": []}
